title: Frederick Myers and the Society for Psychical Research's telepathy model

tellings.quote: this was presumed to be telepathy that was the model that was introduced by Frederick Myers in 1882

plain: In 1882, Frederick Myers of the Society for Psychical Research, an English group set up to study claims of the paranormal, is said to have introduced telepathy, mind-to-mind contact, as the way to explain strange experiences of knowing things one should not know. The researcher Eric Wargo describes this without naming a source, in an episode about prophetic dreams. He tells it to show that such experiences were long presumed to be telepathy, a view he questions.
